scope: Percentage chat progress, combined history filters and current-city learning backdrop
status: passed independent review; latest preview installed

changes.progress: Display whole percentages as n% 聊天进度, clamped to 0...100; 100% is shown only once the actual threshold is reached. Original unlock thresholds and scoring remain unchanged.
changes.filters: Native menu combines 待补答 with all/high/medium/low accuracy. Boundaries reuse the display-color classifier: green >=70%, amber >=50% and <70%, red <50%. Inactive control displays only its icon; active text summarizes the selections. Clear resets both axes. Pending retains the existing meaning: a completed first round with unanswered/correctable questions, excluding ongoing first rounds.
changes.pagination: Filtering applies to loaded history. Existing 更多记录 remains available. An empty filtered page with a next cursor explicitly offers loading more, rather than claiming no history matches.
changes.currentCity: App injects an async profile.currentRegionID reader; the learning page refreshes it when visible, on foreground and on pull-to-refresh. It does not use the companion's hometown. Missing/unknown regions use the shared London fallback.
changes.readability: Challenge, history and loading content use 96% surface cards; Reduce Transparency makes these opaque. Header/bottom wash stabilizes contrast. Decorative static background ignores hit testing and accessibility, adds no gesture or animation, and retains light/dark dynamic text and accuracy colors.
changes.attribution: Existing photo credits now include learning-page use. No image edits, upscaling, new downloads or duplicate asset payloads.

photography.selection: Reuse each city's approved messages_<region>_glass photograph as its learning backdrop.
photography.reuse: Original full-image/native-detail and source/license evidence remains applicable because runtime photos and processing are unchanged. This version reviews the new learning-page crop, foreground coverage, readability and interactions.
photography.dynamicAndLoopChecks: Not applicable: unchanged still photography; no new scene motion.

swift.coverage: Percentage example 56%, 58%, 99%/100%, invalid/excess counts; exact accuracy boundaries and every whole percent; combined pending/accuracy and reset; all 15 resource mappings and unknown/normalized region IDs.
swift.initialInvocation: Package test-target names are not members of the Xcode-hosted scheme. First invocation selected no tests and failed before execution; corrected to the LingoTripTests host target. build/learning-city-filters-swift.log

standardUI.coverage: All 15 city backdrops with real menu taps; three accuracy bands; pending/accuracy composition, empty combination, clear and inactive value; unlocked/locked percentage; large accessibility text in dark mode; journey navigation; vertical scroll, left/right paging and saved chat draft.

compactUI.sourceTiming: Includes the final loading-card legibility change and an additional menu screenshot attachment; loaded-state visuals and tested filter logic are unchanged from the standard run.
compactUI.initialFailure: Tests looked for off-screen elements before scrolling in the smaller viewport. Changed readiness wait and scroll helper to reveal controls/rows in either direction, with oversized accessibility rows allowed to remain scrollable. No product change was required.

visualReview.standardResult: Passed independent review: each city's photograph renders; foreground cards intentionally cover much of the landmark. Percentage, status, inactive icon and active labels remain readable; dark maximum-size history wraps and scrolls without horizontal clipping.
visualReview.computerUse: Selected current Device Hub simulator and requested a screenshot once; the interface again returned a blank image. Used XCTest attachments and simctl screenshots instead; Computer Use interaction verification was unavailable.
visualReview.limitations: No physical-device, live-account or App Store release verification. User aesthetic approval is not claimed.
visualReview.compactResult: Passed: all 15 city backdrops, clear menu labels on 375pt width, combined filter label, and scrollable maximum-size dark history without horizontal clipping.

preview.data: Explicitly labeled local sample progress; no account scoring.
preview.preservation: After space pressure, build-product app was absent at inspection. Restored an APFS clone of the latest passing QA-installed app; main executable and debug-library SHA-256 matched. This exact build was installed and started successfully, and a fresh screenshot inspected.
